OSAP-Net fault lab: diagnose rare bearing faults, reject unseen ones

This page runs the trained OSAP-Net and the base-paper Siamese WDCNN directly in your browser on real CWRU vibration windows. Pick which faults are "known" and how many labelled windows (K) each gets. Then click any incoming window. Faults you did not select have no labels at all, so the correct answer for them is UNKNOWN.

Sensor domain
Known faults (support set)

Unselected faults become previously unseen failures.

Threshold τ for each model and K was calibrated on validation faults only (target false-rejection 5 %), exactly as in the experiments.
